Port Moody Centre, Port Moody: 15 houses and 120 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September, with 2 and 16 sold in the month. It is one of 11 communities the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures break out for Port Moody.
Port Moody Centre homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Port Moody Centre, September 2026. Detached houses: 15 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 13% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 120 listed at month end and 16 sold in September, a sales ratio of 13% (a balanced market).

Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 21 in June to 15 in September (−28.6%), and it took 17.6% of the city’s 51 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 144 in June to 120 in September (−16.7%), and it took 65.2% of the city’s 141 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Port Moody Centre for detached houses in August (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in July (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, August (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in July, September (a buyers’ best bet).
Port Moody Centre share of Port Moody listings and sales by month

In Port Moody Centre, its share of the houses listed in Port Moody went from 16.5% in June to 11.1% in September and its share of the condos and townhomes listed went from 66.7% to 62.5%. A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

blocks.text: Port Moody Centre home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

195 condos sold in Port Moody Centre with a median price of $705,000 (the middle half sold between $602,000 and $797,000), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.7% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $809 per square foot, a median year built of 2012 and a median strata fee of $459 a month. 31 townhomes sold in Port Moody Centre with a median price of $1,112,000 (the middle half sold between $954,500 and $1,181,750), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.9% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $784 per square foot, a median year built of 2012 and a median strata fee of $430 a month.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 15 houses and 120 condos and townhomes listed in Port Moody Centre. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Port Moody Centre a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 13% (a balanced market); condos and townhomes had 13% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Port Moody Centre from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 9 houses and 92 condos and townhomes sold in Port Moody Centre over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in August with 6 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in August with 31 sold.

faq.q: How big is Port Moody Centre compared with the rest of Port Moody?
faq.a: In September 2026, Port Moody Centre held 11.1% of the 135 detached houses listed in Port Moody and 62.5% of the 192 condos and townhomes listed in Port Moody.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 11.1% of the 135 homes listed in Port Moody Centre and condos and townhomes made up 88.9%; of the 18 that sold, houses were 11.1% and condos and townhomes 88.9%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Port Moody Centre than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 21 in June to 15 in September 2026 (−28.6%); condos and townhomes fell from 144 in June to 120 in September 2026 (−16.7%).

faq.q: Is Port Moody Centre an official neighbourhood name?
faq.a: No — it is the board (MLS) sub-area name. The City's Official Community Plan covers the same ground as Moody Centre (Section 14.6) and Inlet Centre (Section 14.5).

faq.q: Which stations serve Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: Moody Centre Station has Millennium Line SkyTrain, West Coast Express and a bus loop, and Inlet Centre Station is the next SkyTrain station east.

faq.q: Are there heritage rules for older homes here?
faq.a: Yes — Moody Centre is a heritage conservation area, so included properties can need a heritage alteration permit for construction or reconstruction.

faq.q: What did condos in Port Moody Centre sell for?
faq.a: 195 condos sold in Port Moody Centre between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $705,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: The median was 26 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.7% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
